scope: currency atomicity from listing to checkout
expected_invariant: Visible amount, currency, breakdown, and restored browser state must remain mutually consistent.
safe_steps: Open a public listing and select dates and one guest.
Record total, breakdown, locale, and currency.
Use Back and Forward and record the restored state.
Repeat in a fresh independent browser context.
Stop before payment submission and reservation creation.

promotion_boundary.F2: One executed capture with complete artifacts.
promotion_boundary.F3: At least two independent attempts reproduce the same inconsistent state.
promotion_boundary.confirmed_defect: Never set automatically; requires Pythia or human review.
